text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, it's done! Roughly like this, I 
suppose. However...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*... I may not have lived up to 
Trainer's expectations, however...

The run itself wasn't bad. However, partly 
due to dancing too much before the race, 
things got a bit chaotic.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Yeah!! Hey, everyone, did ya see that!?

text_block_list.name: 4 Companions
text_block_list.text: Yay!

Tap Dance City isn't just a meathead. 
She's fully capable of running according 
to a strategy. However...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Haha, well, whatever! Racing's all about 
having fun!

At her core, she's the type to run on pure 
vibes. And that temperament isn't just 
limited to actual races—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: It's a GⅠ!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"No, it's a GⅠ! Come on, Trainer, don't 
overthink it. Shouldn't we ride the 
momentum from my debut all the way... 
right?!"
choice_data_list:
No, while steadily aiming for a top 3 
finish...

No, while steadily aiming for a top 3 
finish...

text_block_list.text:
That personality trait was clearly evident 
even when choosing her next objective.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Good grief. Trainer, I really do like you 
to the core, but...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Our charted courses just don't seem to 
align.

Tap Dance City is the type to talk big 
first and figure things out later...

On the other hand, I'm the type who 
prepares thoroughly before going in for 
the gamble. Even if we're both 
risk-takers, our methods are entirely 
different.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Ah, just to make sure... we share the same 
dream, right? We're not wavering on that, 
are we?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
What we're aiming for is to build a 
massive castle where we can live with our 
friends forever!
choice_data_list:
Yeah, and become the world's best 
Umamusume for that!

Yeah, and for that, we'll become the 
world's best Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! Even domestically, we'll stand out 
big time with record-breaking wins!
choice_data_list: And then an overseas campaign, huh!
And then an overseas campaign, right!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
...Whew, that's good! Guess we're aiming 
for the same treasure island after all.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
It's just that how we aim to get there is 
different.

Just getting along isn't enough to weather 
the voyage. We need to align our course.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Now then, as for the immediate matter at 
hand...
choice_data_list:
You really won't budge on challenging a 
Junior Class GⅠ race?

text_block_list.text:
With her current condition, aiming for the 
year-end Junior-class GⅠ is quite a 
gamble.

To be honest, we have to be prepared for 
sudden rough waters, but...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: "Okay, okay. Let's not go there."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Telling me 'don't just dive headfirst 
into a giant octopus' makes total sense, 
after all!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Take on the challenge anyway, or take a 
detour after all? I'll leave that call to 
you!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
But! We might wanna check our 
compatibility just a little more.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
The journey is dizzyingly long. Can the 
two of us really make it work as a duo?

"Not just a playmate. Can we truly make it 
as partners who share an adventure, share 
a destiny?"

I decided to enter many races and test our 
true compatibility.
